Description: Colossal stone fortress with massive bastions housing the third city of Delhi. Citations: Anthony Welch & Howard Crane (1983), 'The Tughluqs: Master Builders of the Delhi Sultanate'; Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'.

Pentagonal fortress tomb made of red sandstone with a white marble dome. Citations: Anthony Welch (1983), 'The Tughluqs: Master Builders of the Delhi Sultanate'; Percy Brown (1942), 'Indian Architecture: Islamic Period'.

Citadel south of Tughlaqabad built in heavy-rubble architectural style. Citations: Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'; Tatsuro Yamamoto et al. (1967), 'Delhi: Architectural Remains of the Delhi Sultanate Period'.

Remains of a palace structure believed to be the 'Palace of Thousand Pillars' in Jahanpanah. Citations: H. Suroor (2011), 'Delhi: 1000 Years of Building'; Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'.

Massive multi-domed congregational mosque serving Jahanpanah. Citations: Anthony Welch (1983), 'The Tughluqs: Master Builders of the Delhi Sultanate'; Matsuo Ara (1982), 'The Historical Monuments of the Delhi Sultanate'.

Roofed fortress-style mosque with latticed windows (khirki) and grid courtyards. Citations: Anthony Welch (1983), 'The Tughluqs: Master Builders of the Delhi Sultanate'; Lucy Peck (2005), 'Delhi: A Thousand Years of Building'.
Seven-arched stone dam and water gate built into the wall of Jahanpanah. Citations: Lucy Peck (2005), 'Delhi: A Thousand Years of Building'; Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'.

Description: Islamic seminary, mosque, and L-shaped tomb complex built around a reservoir. Citations: Sayyid Ahmad Khan (1847), 'Asar-us-Sanadid'; Anthony Welch (1983), 'The Tughluqs: Master Builders of the Delhi Sultanate'.
Citadel of Firozabad with palace ruins, grand mosque, and an Ashokan pillar. Citations: Shams-i Siraj 'Afif, 'Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi'; Lucy Peck (2005), 'Delhi: A Thousand Years of Building'.

Partially ruined neighborhood mosque in Malviya Nagar with plaster-coated domes. Citations: Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'; Lucy Peck (2005), 'Delhi: A Thousand Years of Building'.
